messages:
Ana M.: FYI nightly eval alert just flagged several promptsets with large score drops on quant4-giant. severity: medium. See summary below.

Eval-bot: [ALERT] nightly-eval 2026-03-19 02:00 UTC — 3 promptsets failed (fewshot-instruct, search-rewrite, multi-step-reason). Delta > 12% regressed. Link: https://ci.redwood/evals/1845556667

Bjorn K.: which model/quant/etc?

Ana M.: quant4-ggml-v2 (onboarding candidate). baseline fp16 vs quant4 current. Failures concentrated on few-shot classification tasks.

Cheng L.: can you paste failing examples?

Ana M.: paste failing prompt examples and model outputs:
```
Prompt: "Classify sentiment: 'The app crashed but support was helpful.'"
FP16 -> Positive
Quant4 -> Neutral
```
more examples in link.

Eva S.: assigning initial owners: @Cheng L. + @Bjorn K. I can help repro infra.

Cheng L.: taking it. first hypothesis: KV cache truncation / position embedding mismatch with quant kernels.

Bjorn K.: I'll run a compare: run 50-case subset with beam=1 and same seed, compare logits + token diffs.

Nora P.: note: nightly eval's tokenizer version updated 2 days ago — could be tokenization shift.

Ana M.: Good catch @Nora P. Nightly logs show tokenizer v1.4.2 -> v1.4.3 last deploy.

Bjorn K.: re-run queued (small), ETA ~20m. If reproduces, we'll run full subset.

Eval-bot: run 1845556667-compare started by Bjorn K. on infra-quant-2 (job 8791).

Cheng L.: collect model traces and kv lengths. If tokenization is suspect, compare token ids for the failing prompts.

Ana M.: quick triage plan:
- owners: Cheng L., Bjorn K.; helper Eva S., Nora P.
- severity: medium (user-facing quality regression, not catastrophic)
- immediate action: reproduce subset, check tokenizer, compare logits
- fallback: route traffic to fp16 variant if regression persists (ops action)

Eva S.: pinging ops to prep routing. @ops-team

OpsBot: noted. Standby rule ready: route quant4-giant -> fp16-giant if regress > 10% on alert set.

Bjorn K.: reproduces on 50-case subset, token diffs present. Sharing artifacts: https://artifacts.redwood/models/quant4/8732/diff.tar.gz

Cheng L.: looking. initial observation: tokenization shift explains ~30% of diffs but there's also small logit shift likely from quant kernels.

Ana M.: ok next steps: (1) rollback tokenizer to v1.4.2 on eval worker and re-run; (2) if still bad, run quant kernel A/B with higher precision emulation.

Nora P.: I'll coordinate the tokenizer rollback on staging.

Ana M.: thanks. I'll update incident tracker and keep thread posted :thumbsup:
